answer: Trust is priced per proof: 163 POA each, and the farm's 802 proofs tie up 130726 POA it will never see again if it cheats. The farm rehearsed the cipher, it rehearsed the pigment, but it never rehearsed the quartz, because a year cannot be rehearsed. A real proof answers three questions at once: who, when, and by whose hand. One proof settles it, and the proof is Colour grinder colour pot assay dyed in the dye cellar, witnessed as each colour pot is a dye record witnessed by the inspector. A single alias pays 163 POA and waits 8 days; a farm pays 130726 POA and still waits 8 days per alias.
